This programme/post is labelled as a “pilot rotation”. This means that this programme has been created as part of a commitment to reduce the impact of rotations on Resident Doctors. In 2024, the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and the British Medical Association (BMA) agreed to a jointly-led review of rotational training and in Autumn 2025 the NHS England 10 Point Plan for Resident Doctors committed to launching pilots with reformed rotational changes for August 2026. This programme/post is one of these pilots.All pilot posts meet standard curriculum requirements and do not affect training progression. If you preference one of these posts, you may be asked to provide feedback on your experience as part of the evaluation process. Participation in the evaluation is not mandatory. More information can be found in the News Bulletin and FAQ sections of Oriel.

This programme/post is labelled as a “pilot rotation”. This means that this programme has been created as part of a commitment to reduce the impact of rotations on Resident Doctors. In 2024, the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and the British Medical Association (BMA) agreed to a jointly-led review of rotational training and in Autumn 2025 the NHS England 10 Point Plan for Resident Doctors committed to launching pilots with reformed rotational changes for August 2026. This programme/post is one of these pilots.All pilot posts meet standard curriculum requirements and do not affect training progression. If you preference one of these posts, you may be asked to provide feedback on your experience as part of the evaluation process. Participation in the evaluation is not mandatory. More information can be found in the News Bulletin and FAQ sections of Oriel.
IM1 and IM2 years each consist of 3 x 4 month rotations at Frimley Park Hospital.
IMT1 - Endocrinology,Geriatric Medicine, Haematology/ITU , 
IMT2 - Acute Internal Medicine , Respiratory/MADU, Rheumatology
K80=FRIM12
Pilot rotation

 All pilot posts meet standard curriculum requirements and do not affect training progression. In 2024, the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and the British Medical Association (BMA) agreed to a jointly-led review of rotational training and in Autumn 2025 the NHS England 10 Point Plan for Resident Doctors (https://www.england.nhs.uk/long-read/10-point-plan-to-improve-resident-doctors-working-lives/) committed to launching pilots with reformed rotational changes for August 2026. This programme/post is one of these pilots.
 All pilot posts meet standard curriculum requirements and do not affect training progression. If you preference one of these posts, you may be asked to provide feedback on your experience as part of the evaluation process. Participation in the evaluation is not mandatory. More information can be found in the News Bulletin and FAQ sections of Oriel.
IMT Year 1:London North West University Healthcare NHS Trust  
IMT Year 2: London North West University Healthcare NHS Trust 
Placements rotating between: 
[IMT1] -  Aug-26: Ealing Hospital: Acute Internal Medicine, Nov-27:Northwick Park Hospital - Intensive Care Medicine,  Feb-27:Northwick Park Hospital - Haematology/Acute internal Medicine
[IMT2] - Aug-27: Northwick Park Hospital - Geriatrics, Feb-28:Northwick Park Hospital - Gastroenterology,
If you rank this post and apply for IMT3, your IMT3 allocation will be at one of these posts:
Ealing Hospital – Acute internal Medicine
Ealing Hospital - Respiratory Medicine
Ealing Hospital - Geriatric Medicine

programmes.offerCode: London - South London - IMT - L275=SW18A
programmes.description:
This programme/post is labelled as a “pilot rotation”. This means that this programme has been created as part of a commitment to reduce the impact of rotations on Resident Doctors. 
In 2024, the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and the British Medical Association (BMA) agreed to a jointly-led review of rotational training and in Autumn 2025 the NHS England 10 Point Plan for Resident Doctors (https://www.england.nhs.uk/long-read/10-point-plan-to-improve-resident-doctors-working-lives/) committed to launching pilots with reformed rotational changes for August 2026. This programme/post is one of these pilots.
 All pilot posts meet standard curriculum requirements and do not affect training progression. If you preference one of these posts, you may be asked to provide feedback on your experience as part of the evaluation process. Participation in the evaluation is not mandatory. More information can be found in the News Bulletin and FAQ sections of Oriel.
Each rotation is for 4 months.
IM1
1. Croydon Health Service NHS Trust, Croydon University Hospital: Acute Medicine
2. Croydon Health Service NHS Trust, Croydon University Hospital: Endocrinology
3. Croydon Health Service NHS Trust, Croydon University Hospital: Geriatric Medicine
*Please note these rotations may not be in this order*
IM2
1. Croydon Health Service NHS Trust, Croydon University Hospital: Respiratory Medicine/GIM
2. Croydon Health Service NHS Trust, Croydon University Hospital: Intensive Care (Mayday Hospital)
3. Croydon Health Service NHS Trust, Croydon University Hospital: Gastroenterology
*Please note these rotations may not be in this order*
